Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Масло' is the accusative direct object of 'купил'. As a neuter noun its accusative matches the nominative, with 'в магазине' locating the purchase.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Масла' takes the genitive after 'нет', stating that there is no butter. 'В холодильнике' locates the lack.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Маслом' is in the instrumental after 'с', meaning bread together with butter. 'Вкусный' praises the result.
Strategic focus: Genitive of quantity. 'Масла' takes the genitive after 'немного', expressing a small amount. The imperative 'добавь' directs the action into the porridge.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of medium. 'Масле' takes the prepositional form after 'на' to show the oil the fish is fried in. A natural cooking pattern.
Strategic focus: Accusative object with direction. 'Масло' is the accusative object of 'намазал', while 'на хлеб' shows where it was spread. The form matches the nominative for this neuter noun.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Масла' takes the genitive after 'цена', expressing the price of the butter. 'Выросла' agrees with the feminine subject 'цена'.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Масла' is the accusative plural object of 'пробовали', matching the nominative plural form. 'Разные' agrees in the plural, describing the varieties.
Strategic focus: Genitive of quantity. 'Масла' takes the genitive after 'много', expressing a large amount. 'В этом блюде' locates the oil in the dish.
